displayPattern: PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic display in Goodman service manual RS6200007 r27 (ASXC, DSXC, GSXC condensing units and ASZC, DSZC, GSZC heat pumps). Digit 3 is blank. Digit 2 is L and digit 1 is 7. The code is L7
meaning: Open run-circuit lockout. The open run circuit was detected 4 times, with a 5-minute delay between each detection. The compressor and outdoor fan are off.
causes: Compressor not wired to the control
diySteps: Write down L7. The single open-run trip is 07. L7 is the lockout after four detections
Technician: check the compressor and the wiring. The chart says this lockout must be cleared by cycling 24 VAC to the control
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. L7 is a lockout of the run circuit, not a pressure-switch code.
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
